createBooking.title: Create booking
createBooking.subtitle: Fill in the booking creation form

faq.title: Frequently Ask Questions
faq.subtitle: In this section you will find all the information about our services.

q1.title: How to create a booking?
q1.subtitle: To create a booking it is necessary to follow the following steps:
q1.p1: Enter the scheduled date of entry to the parking lot, followed by the date of departure.
q1.p3: Enter the license plate of the truck that will enter the parking lot.
q1.p4: Enter the license plate number of the trailer that will enter the parking lot.
q1.p5: Select the parking lot where the booking will be made.
q1.p7: (Optional) Add a description to your booking.

q2.title: How to buy credits for your bookings?
q2.subtitle: To purchase credits you must do the following:
q2.p1: Select a specific plan from those available in the list.
q2.p3: Fill in the card payment form with the information corresponding to the buyer (Name, Card No., Month, Year, CCV).
q2.p4: Finalize the purchase by pressing on the button ''{text}''.

q1.title: How to see the reservations assigned to your parking lot?
q1.subtitle: To view all bookings you must do the following:
q1.p1: In the side menu click on ''{booking}'' and then ''{all}''.
q1.p2: In the table you can see the corresponding booking fields, and two buttons: ''{edit}'' to change the reservation status and ''{delete}'' to delete the reservation assigned to your parking lot.
